tables.name: error_event
tables.note: One browser error as it happened: message, stack, page, release and device.

tables.name: error_issue
tables.note: Browser errors grouped by fingerprint, so the same error is one issue.

tables.name: session
tables.note: One visitor's session on a website, with the browser, OS, device, screen, language and location seen.

tables.name: website
tables.note: A site being tracked. Sessions, events and reports belong to a website.

tables.name: website_event
tables.note: One page view or custom event in a session.
